checkedAlternates.risk: Marble is a metamorphic rock like slate and schist.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Marble lacks parallel mineral alignment (foliation) and is non-foliated metamorphic (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Shale splits into thin layers like slate.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Shale is a clastic sedimentary rock (group-4) that becomes metamorphic slate only after heat and pressure.
